ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of high-intensity white pixels on the lateral lobes to low-intensity dark pixels in the central region.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centralized contiguous low-intensity region forming an inverted triangular shape from the peduncle to the trailing edge. High-intensity contiguous blobs dominate the distal lobes. High-frequency pixel mottling and stippling are present along the transitional boundary between the dark and light regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped depression with a wide obtuse angle (~120 degrees) and minimal vertical penetration depth into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the entire margin. Right lobe trailing edge exhibits higher amplitude peak-to-valley variations than the left. Distal tips show highly irregular, ragged pixel boundaries.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Double-convex curve along the trailing edge, transitioning to a minor concavity immediately adjacent to the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small dark circular clusters visible along the right lateral margin and concentrated near the peduncle base within the dark pigmentation zone.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple high-contrast white linear tracks (rake marks) concentrated in the central dark zone, including a prominent parallel pair on the right-center and a cross-shaped 'X' intersection in the upper-left dark quadrant. A single dark curved line is present on the far-left white lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive parallel-line scarring (rake marks) across the central pigmentation. Irregular, jagged tissue morphology at the extreme right lobe tip suggesting previous trauma or wear.
other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast white intersecting lines forming a cross pattern in the upper central dark region; suspended water droplets visible at the fluke tips.
